files.html:
Dochi RPG Maker 0.1.1

Dochi RPG Maker 0.1.1 is a Forge 1.20.1 / CustomNPCs update focused on the 0.1.0 → 0.1.1 migration, addon support, GUI Maker improvements, NPC Shop usability, dialogue stability, and multiplayer synchronization.

Highlights

  • Renamed the mod ID and default resource namespace from dochi_game_editor to dochi_rpg_maker.
  • Introduced the foundation for addon/API registries.
  • Expanded GUI Maker with new components, vanilla button support, and transaction preview.
  • Completely overhauled the NPC Shop buy/sell workflow.
  • Improved Dialogue Editor, multiplayer JSON synchronization, and default resource management.

Breaking Changes

  • Renamed the mod ID from dochi_game_editor to dochi_rpg_maker.
  • Runtime data folder changed to dochi_rpg_maker.
  • Default resources moved to dochi_rpg_maker_defaults.
  • Updated default GUI filenames.
  • Updating both the server and all clients to 0.1.1 is strongly recommended.

Added

API / Framework

  • Added addon-facing API registries.
  • Added server-side default settings.
  • Added language resources.

Currency Editor

  • Added Set Default for newly created shops.

Dialogue Editor

  • Added Set Default for dialogue GUI selection.
  • Added searchable GUI selection.
  • Added Create New / Save As workflow.
  • Added @playername replacement.
  • Added text colors and formatting.
  • Added Tab / Shift+Tab navigation.

GUI Maker

  • Added Button Config.
  • Added vanilla button rendering support.
  • Added vanilla button policy lockouts.
  • Added search bar, page selector, transaction viewer, item description, and optional inventory components.
  • Added separate Buy/Sell layout configuration.
  • Added editor GUI scale assist.

NPC Shop

  • Added multi-buy support.
  • Added transaction preview.
  • Added item descriptions.
  • Added improved sell workflow with quantity controls.
  • Added comma-formatted currency display.
  • Added optional vanilla inventory rendering.

NPC

  • Added global faction editing support.

Changed

Core

  • Migrated all assets to the new namespace.
  • Updated bundled default resources.
  • Improved dedicated server JSON synchronization.
  • Improved runtime dialogue fallback behavior.

GUI Maker

  • Updated default component templates.
  • Improved GUI search behavior.
  • Improved render order and preview rendering.

NPC Shop

  • Updated default shop layout.
  • Made player inventory optional.
  • Improved Buy/Sell layout handling.
  • Improved row alignment and runtime behavior.

Dialogue

  • Improved command execution context.
  • Improved translation handling.
  • Improved Dialogue Save As behavior.

Other

  • Updated Currency definitions to use existing Minecraft items.
  • Improved Combat & AI editor layout.
  • Improved TACZ Fire editor integration.
  • Improved Drop Table editor layout.

Fixed

Currency

  • Fixed HUD visibility issues.
  • Fixed currency synchronization.
  • Fixed stale multiplayer balances.
  • Fixed fake pickup HUD effects.

NPC Shop

  • Fixed drag-and-drop persistence.
  • Fixed sell quantity popup rendering.
  • Fixed vanilla button rendering.
  • Fixed sell offer selection.
  • Fixed inventory rendering.
  • Fixed transaction preview visibility.

Dialogue

  • Fixed stale JSON loading.
  • Fixed choice rendering.
  • Fixed blank choice labels.
  • Fixed GUI JSON search.
  • Fixed Save As path handling.
  • Fixed text cursor and rendering issues.

GUI Maker

  • Fixed preview sizing.
  • Fixed Inspector layout issues.
  • Fixed text field clipping.
  • Fixed button labels.

NPC

  • Fixed URL skin rendering.
  • Fixed persistent metadata storage.
  • Fixed NPC spawning.
  • Fixed apply screen synchronization.
  • Fixed unsaved changes confirmation.
  • Fixed nameplate and animation application.

Misc

  • Fixed editor UI alignment, margins, centering, and overlap issues.
